scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const src='resource/templates';const dst='dist/resource/templates';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src))fs.copyFileSync(p.join(src,f),p.join(dst,f));"
scripts.zip: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const tmp='deploy-tmp';fs.rmSync(tmp,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(tmp);function copyDir(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const a=path.join(s,f),b=path.join(d,f);fs.statSync(a).isDirectory()?copyDir(a,b):fs.copyFileSync(a,b)}}copyDir('dist',tmp);fs.copyFileSync('package.json',path.join(tmp,'package.json'));if(fs.existsSync('package-lock.json'))fs.copyFileSync('package-lock.json',path.join(tmp,'package-lock.json'));if(fs.existsSync('deploy-backend.zip'))fs.unlinkSync('deploy-backend.zip');execSync('powershell -Command Compress-Archive -Path deploy-tmp\\* -DestinationPath deploy-backend.zip -Force',{stdio:'inherit'});fs.rmSync(tmp,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Готово: deploy-backend.zip');"
